title: Research
expectedInputs: You get: a cited dossier — Question, Findings, Sources — you can reopen, download, or send to Documents, Presentation, or the Knowledge Base.
emptyBody: Enter a question below. Pages are read over HTTPS.
promptPlaceholder: What changed in IDX listing rules this year?
examplesHint: Click a card to load a full brief. Replace the sample details, then generate.

competitive-landscape.title: Competitive landscape
competitive-landscape.resultSummary: A sourced landscape with a buyer job, three real products, and dated change — not three adjectives.

source-synthesis.title: Source synthesis
source-synthesis.resultSummary: A theme map with disagreements and a kill-criterion — not a stacked summary of the same take.

question-backlog.title: Question backlog
question-backlog.resultSummary: Twelve ranked questions with a method and a done-looks-like — not a brainstorm dump.

claim-check.title: Claim check
claim-check.resultSummary: A verdict on one claim with a flip-condition — not a both-sides paragraph.

options-matrix.title: Options matrix
options-matrix.resultSummary: A scored option grid with explicit unknowns and a week-1 kill metric.

vendor-diligence.title: Vendor diligence
vendor-diligence.resultSummary: A sourced diligence note with a fit verdict and ‘not published’ gaps — not a brochure rewrite.

errorGateway: Research needs a live gateway. Paste a Toko Token API key in Settings, then try again.
errorSearch: Web search did not return results. Try again in a moment.
errorNoHttps: Search returned no readable HTTPS results for this question
unreadPage: Could not read page: {reason}. Search snippet kept above.
languageRule: Write every user-facing string (title, summary, finding headings and bodies, contradictions, openQuestions, and source notes) in English. Keep JSON keys, source ids such as [S1], URLs, and verbatim passages unchanged.
stubSummary: Offline demo. No web search ran. Confidence: low. Thin evidence: this stand-in exists so Research still produces a dossier when the runtime is stub. Save a Toko Token API key in Settings to research the question from HTTPS pages.
stubFindingHeading: This is a stub, not a web finding
stubFindingBody: DPSBuddy returned this dossier because the runtime is stub. It does not cite live pages for: {question}. Paste a Toko Token key in Settings, then generate again.
stubSourceNotes: Synthetic source for the offline demo. Not a page that was read.
stubContradiction: No source disagreement — search did not run.
stubOpenQuestion: What changes after a gateway key is saved?
